comment: The kaleidoscope and the reload clauses of the session, kept in step with the filter dialog and the modules folder under the data root. Staged by hand before the run, the painter's path and not the harness's: the data root's modules folder holds kaleidoscope, a plain copy of the packaged module's folder, my-kaleidoscope, the same copy with get_id and get_name changed to my_kaleidoscope and My Kaleidoscope, and my-tint, a copy of tests/fixtures/r2-reload/modules/r2-reload-fixture, each without its tests folder and its .uid files. A capture's data root is scratch/xdg/config/sara/data, and the settings key keeps it. The run shoots the Modules menu with the plain copy refused, opens My Kaleidoscope's dialog by its registry key, applies it, undoes it and applies it again with the dialog's Attach box ticked, adds a layer of the tint's type, then presses Modules > Reload Modules with nothing edited and shoots both menus and the canvas again. The layers docker and the strokes sit inside 1280 by 1024, so the file runs unchanged on any screen.
